  [INFO] Legend present: prefer direct end-of-line labels to avoid eye ping-pong (Beautiful Evidence).
  [INFO] Bar chart: ensure baseline starts at zero (set_ylim(bottom=0)) — no truncated baselines.

3 heuristic flag(s). Advisory only — review each against intent and the Tufte checklist.

adjudication.flag: INFO: legend present — prefer direct end-of-line labels
adjudication.verdict: DELIBERATE DEVIATION, 2 places. (a) fig_s4 middle panel: the grouped delivered/updated bars sit too close for two direct labels — they collided on first render; a 2-entry frameless legend is strictly more legible. (b) fig_s3 left panel: three overlaid marker families NEED a key; without it the figure was unreadable (caught in by-eye review). Everywhere else labels are direct/in-panel.

adjudication.flag: INFO: bar chart — ensure baseline starts at zero
adjudication.verdict: SATISFIED. Every bar axis is set_ylim(0, ...) / set_xlim(0, ...); the panels say so ('bars start at 0'). Lie factor ~1: no truncated baselines anywhere.

adjudication.flag: INFO: dB detected — state linear/dB explicitly
adjudication.verdict: SATISFIED / false positive. No axis is in dB. 'dB' appears only in the NAME of the FEM+6dB incumbent envelope (the ratio's denominator) and in the A5b caption text. All magnitude axes are linear |G| on log scales; frequency axes are log (project rule); the captions state this.

notes: A clean lint is not proof of a good figure; the by-eye review in out/fig_qa.json is the real check, and it caught the missing marker key that the linter cannot see.
